name: Confidence
overview: Scripture reveals that confidence misplaced in human effort or pride leads to folly, as seen in the builders of Babel who sought to make a name for themselves and reach heaven by their own strength. True confidence, by contrast, is grounded in the Lord, who raises deliverers like Ehud in response to Israel's cries for help. Yet the heart that turns away from God and trusts in its own imagination is warned of judgment and failure, illustrating the danger of false confidence apart from faithfulness to God.
